meta.title: piliens · Seven ways a drop can look
meta.description: Seven ways a drop can look: dew point, river, ink, rain, dew, time and a mushroom. One drop from the air to the sea — a nature site with Dainis's photographs.
meta.og: One drop from the air to the sea. Seven ways a drop can look.
hero.tagline: Seven ways a drop can look.
lase.text: A riverbed through shallow water. Every ripple redraws the net of light on the stones.
lase.hint: Click or drag across the water.
lase.aria: A shallow river with tea-brown water; pebbles and sand show through it, crossed by a net of light. Press Enter to let a droplet fall.
tinte.text: A drop of ink in a glass of water. It never spreads the same way twice.
tinte.aria: A glass of water against a window; a drop of ink unfurls into vortex rings. Press Enter to add ink.
lietus.text: Morning behind an old window. The big drops swallow the small ones and slide away.
lietus.hint: Drag across the misted glass to wipe it.
lietus.aria: A misted old window with a frosty morning behind it; drops on the glass. The cursor wipes the mist away.
rasa.hint: Move the cursor over the photo: it becomes a drop.
rasa.aria: A photograph with dewdrops; the cursor moves over it like a magnifying drop of water.
rasa.s0.text: Lupin leaves after rain. In the middle of each leaf a single drop has gathered, and it works like a lens.
rasa.s1.text: A lady's mantle leaf. The plant itself pushes out the tiny drops along its toothed edge at night.
rasa.s2.text: A drop at the heart of a star of lupin leaves. Every leaflet is mirrored in it at once.
rasa.s2.alt: A drop in a star of lupin leaves
rasa.s3.text: Hoarfrost. The same water from the air, only frozen into needles.
rasa.s4.text: The edge of an autumn forest. You can guide the drop over the coloured leaves too.
rasa.s4.alt: The edge of an autumn forest
rasa.s5.text: A bee at an amber-coloured drop. Sometimes sweetness, too, is just a single drop.
rasa.s5.alt: A bee at an amber-coloured drop
rasa.s6.text: A chanterelle under frosted leaves. A drop still hangs from a blade of grass; it hasn't had time to freeze.
rasa.s7.text: Drops on waterproof fabric. They cannot soak in, so they pull themselves into beads.

laiks.count.one: drop since you opened this page. One every second, and the moss grows greener.
laiks.count.other: drops since you opened this page. One every second, and the moss grows greener.

sene.text: A scalycap in an autumn forest. Mist condenses on its cap into a single drop until the drop grows too heavy.
sene.hint: Hold the cursor over the mushroom to bring the mist. A click lets the drop fall.
sene.hintTouch: Tap the mushroom: the drop will roll off. Drag your finger over it to bring the mist.
sene.aria: A yellow-orange scalycap in an autumn forest; a drop of water sits on its cap with the forest upside down inside it. Press Enter to let the drop fall.
